payload.summary: PLAN_REVIEW did not converge. The revised plan still has three critical lifecycle and merge-routing contract blockers plus three recovery/package nits. Codex produced the only valid review; Antigravity, Claude, Grok, and Pi produced no valid findings, so external quorum was 0/4 and the single-vendor consensus artifact remains non-quorate. Its automatic zero-blocking summary must not override the primary critical findings.
completed_work: Read proposal, design, tasks, all delta specs, contracts, and work-packages.yaml after Plan Iteration 2.
Wrote and schema-validated 8 Codex findings: 3 critical, 3 nit, and 2 positive observations.
Attempted review dispatch to Antigravity, Claude, Grok, and Pi; review-manifest.json records that no vendor produced a valid result.
Synthesized consensus-plan.json from the only valid review; quorum was not met and all findings remain unconfirmed.

decisions.title: Plan review is not converged
decisions.rationale: Expired takeover lacks an implementable process-evidence contract, operator delivery-stage overrides are not bound to the reviewed SHAs, and release-owner can expose preserved work without quarantine.

next_steps: Define the local process-evidence record and stale/live decision rules used by expired-lease takeover, with PID-reuse and indeterminate fixtures.
Bind every operator delivery-stage override to the inspected base/head SHAs and invalidate it when either SHA changes.
Make release-owner quarantine or safely dispose every preserved matching checkout before clearing ownership.
Specify the parent remote ref and push ordering that prove integrated package worktrees durable before teardown.
Add owner-fenced reconciliation for a crash after Git worktree removal but before registry deletion.
Complete the recovery-adopt field, output, exit-code, and failure contract, then rerun multi-vendor PLAN_REVIEW.
